name: Belgrade bypass toll (Obilaznica oko Beograda), category 4
law: JP Putevi Srbije's price list for the Belgrade bypass from 2026-04-01 (posebna naknada za upotrebu javnog puta, putarina): category 4 (four or more axles, over 3,500 kg) pays per section between two interchanges, in RSD, by TAG without barriers; other categories don't pay. Each section is a toll point in the middle of each carriageway, paid in its direction (placed on OpenStreetMap's A1 bypass carriageways between the interchanges' junctions).
